description:
List the marginalia attached to a note. A marginalia is working material the user keeps ALONGSIDE a note without it entering the text: an idea, a reference, a link, an excerpt pasted to rewrite a passage later. They are never published, and they are meant to be TEMPORARY — anything worth keeping becomes a note or a linked task.

Each one is either attached to a specific passage (`quote` is set) or to the whole note (`quote` is null).
name: list_note_comments
